official_provenance_chain.title: ConFIG: Towards Conflict-free Training of Physics Informed Neural Networks

api.gradient_shape: three rows [fit, keep, track] by shared active parameter coordinates
api.normalization: row gradient divided by its norm; official zero row uses nan_to_num
api.official_length: unit candidate multiplied by sum of projections of original loss gradients onto it
api.weight_shape: [number_of_losses], equal to one; official EqualWeight uses default floating dtype
api.dtype_policy: FP32 inputs and unmodified official solve; float64 only for checks and scalar rescaling
api.none_semantics: official helper default skip cannot align different per-loss usage; local wrapper uses one fixed named parameter list, zeros only for per-loss missing coordinates, and preserves None for parameters unused by every loss
api.local_norm_control: successful official candidate rescaled to grouped ordinary sum L2 before Adam; explicitly local experimental control, not an author default
api.group_sum_order: (fit + keep) + track; original scalar full_F gradient checked separately by caller

fallback_rules.input_errors: nonfinite original gradient or ordinary sum, shape/dtype/device/coordinate mismatch raise; no silent numerical fallback
fallback_rules.zero_sum: retain exact ordinary zero gradient for used parameters and still execute the original Adam step
fallback_rules.all_unused: all corresponding gradients remain None; original Adam therefore leaves their parameters and state unchanged
fallback_rules.fallback_output: exact grouped ordinary sum, preserving joint active/None mask; never skip optimizer step
fallback_rules.fallback_logging: diagnostics record used_mode, fallback_reason and available solver/projection/norm diagnostics

scope_and_limits: Paper primary experiments are PINNs; section 4.2 also studies CelebA multi-task learning. It does not validate infrared target detection.

The paper appendix and official troubleshooting discuss gradient length and Adam momentum interactions; compatibility of raw directions is not a guarantee of actual Adam descent, loss decrease, or missed-target recovery.
Repository README BibTeX year is 2024; publication identity is bound to the official ICLR 2025 proceedings.
CPU synthetic checks verify only the newly added operator and None/Adam semantics. They do not repeat old detector integration tests.
No real-checkpoint ConFIG step, GPU operator check, or training has been run in this source-check task. Those actions remain gated by stage-one update evidence.

cpu_test_evidence.scope: Official normal-case direction, fixed-coordinate None behavior, Adam zero-vs-None semantics, numerical fallback and malformed input checks only.
